```sql
WITH selected_orders AS (
    SELECT o.id
      FROM orders o
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
selected_lines AS (
    SELECT ol.order_id, ol.variant_id::uuid AS variant_id, ol.quantity, ol.line_total_cents
      FROM order_lines ol
      JOIN selected_orders so ON so.id = ol.order_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       count(DISTINCT sl.order_id)     AS order_count,
       sum(sl.quantity)                AS quantity,
       sum(sl.line_total_cents)        AS revenue_cents,
       count(DISTINCT pv.id)           AS variant_count
  FROM selected_lines sl
  JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = sl.variant_id
  JOIN products p          ON p.id = pv.product_id
 GROUP BY p.id, p.sku, p.name, p.brand, p.currency
 ORDER BY quantity DESC, revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De orderselectie wordt eerst gedaan op de filters van `orders`, zodat alleen die regels verder worden verwerkt, en de cast wordt één keer toegepast. De aggregaties en kolomtypes blijven gelijk aan het origineel, dus het resultaat is hetzelfde. De winst hangt af van het plan, dus controleer dit met `EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)`, omdat de planner van PostgreSQL 16 het origineel vaak al vergelijkbaar optimaliseert.
